e_open.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Two of you out of one sky in one night. The war is generous. Names and ranks — you first, the talker.
Again two airmen, again one night. Very well. Names and ranks. Start with the one who cannot keep still.

willis1.speaker: WILLIS
lines: Flight Sergeant Raymond Willis, RAF. Navigator — 103 Squadron, Lancasters, out of Elsham Wolds. Flak got us past Cambrai, port wing gone, and I've been walking three nights—
Willis. Flight Sergeant, RAF, navigator. 103 Squadron — Lancasters, Elsham Wolds. We came apart past Cambrai and I have walked every night since—

e_probe.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Cambrai is a long walk, Flight Sergeant. And yet your boots say otherwise.
From Cambrai, on those boots. A remarkable walk.

willis2.speaker: WILLIS
lines: I kept to the fields, exactly like the lectures — the button compass, the silk map, all of it. Ask me anything you like. I counted four chutes when the Halifax came apart, four good chutes—
Fields only, like the escape lectures say — button compass, silk map. Test me on anything. When the Halifax broke up I counted four chutes out—

e_catch.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: The Halifax.
A moment. The Halifax, you say.

willis3.speaker: WILLIS
lines: The— the Lanc. I mean the Lanc. Three years flying, you mix the names, it was dark— you understand how it is.
Lancaster — I said Lancaster. Slip of the tongue, man. It was pitch dark and I have not slept—

e_turn.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: And you, the quiet one. Tail gunner. You flew with a thousand men like him. What do your ears say?
Now the American. You know bomber crews, tail gunner. Tell me what you heard just now.

choices.text: He said Lancaster. Then he said Halifax. Nobody mixes those.
He's shaken, that's all. We're all shaken. He's real.

e_doubt.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: No. Nobody mixes those.
So your ears work. No — nobody mixes those.

e_vouch.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: You vouch. On one hour in the dark, you spend your word. I will remember how cheaply it goes.
One hour in the dark and you give him your word. I note what your word costs you.

e_silent.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: A careful man. Or an empty one. We will learn which.
Silence. Careful, or empty. The night will tell us.

e_close.speaker: ÉTIENNE
lines: Enough. Take the Flight Sergeant to the other barn. We continue with the American.
That is enough. The other barn for the Flight Sergeant. The American stays.
